Table 6 -- top perovskite/oxide candidates & PARTIALLY REPRODUCES & Rows 1--12 match the deposited code exactly. Rows 13--14 of the manuscript (SrZrYAlO$_6$, YAlO$_3$) are not ranks 13--14 of the code, which returns HoAlO$_{3}$, CaHfMgZrO$_{6}$. \\
Table 7 -- Pareto front & REPRODUCES & All 7 rows and all utilities reproduce exactly. See report for the floating-point fragility of the KTaO$_3$ entry. \\
Table 8 -- Pareto contribution by dataset & REPRODUCES & Castelli 5 / 0.733 / 0.758 and Wolverton 2 / 0.873 / 0.888 reproduce exactly. \\
Table 9 -- candidate-pool summary & REPRODUCES & 18{,}928 / 4{,}914 / 1{,}306 records and all summary statistics reproduce exactly. \\
Table 10 -- objective sensitivity & REPRODUCES & All five profiles, top formulas, scores and top-50 overlaps reproduce exactly. \\
Table 11 -- diverse acquisition batch & REPRODUCES (but truncated) & The 12 printed rows match rows 1--12 of the code's 20-row batch exactly. The manuscript text calls this ``the 12 candidates''; the deposited code emits 20. \\
Table 12 -- validation-gate summary & REPRODUCES THE CODE, BUT THE CODE IS WRONG & The printed counts (9/8/4/1/1) reproduce the deposited script exactly, but they sum to 23 for a 20-candidate batch because \texttt{candidate\_validation\_pack.py} re-merges the batch onto a ranked table with duplicate formulas (BaNbO$_3$, KTaO$_3$, LaScO$_3$ each appear twice). \\
